'''Abo''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Lehon system]], which was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> At some point prior to [[25,200 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] harnessed its energy to power their [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based factory, the [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
